title: Check Lucky Number (All Digits Unique)

content.problemStatement:
Lucky Number

Problem Statement

Write a program to check a given number is Lucky number or not

Note: If all digits in a given number are different, then it is called lucky number

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Check if all digits in number are distinct.
solution.editorial: Count occurrences of digits; if no digit repeats print YES, else NO.

hints: Check if any digit appears more than once.
